title: Someone Was Impersonating Her in Online Affairs. She Says It Was Her Husband.

reading.body:
The incident involves online impersonation in which someone adopted the identity of a public figure, Collien Fernandes, to conduct sexually explicit affairs with other people and to distribute pornographic material attributed to her. Some of that material depicted other women or was artificially generated rather than genuine images of Fernandes. This places AI-generated imagery at one layer of the abuse, used to lend false credibility to the impersonation.

The failure here is not a malfunction of a single deployed system but the weaponisation of generative tools, combined with basic identity fraud, against a real person. No platform or verification mechanism detected or stopped the impersonation over the period it continued. The conduct persisted long enough that Fernandes had to conduct her own investigation to identify a perpetrator, a task that fell to her because no institutional check caught it first.

What is not established is guilt: Fernandes says she believes her husband is responsible, but that is an allegation, not a legal finding, and no verdict is reported in the available sources.

reports.title: Someone Was Impersonating Her in Online Affairs. She Says It Was Her Husband.

summary:
German actress and television personality Collien Fernandes discovered that someone was impersonating her online and engaging in sexually explicit affairs with men using her name. The impersonator also created and shared pornographic material purportedly featuring her, though it often showed other women or was artificially generated. After years of harassment, Fernandes learned about a disturbing video in 2021 that prompted her to take action. She decided to investigate her digital harassers as a journalist would, determined to identify the person responsible for the abuse.

By late March, Fernandes believed she had finally identified one of her impersonators, a man conducting explicit online affairs in her name. On a Thursday evening while filming a television series in Vietnam, she made time in her hotel room to expose this person. Her investigation and subsequent revelations sparked a feminist movement in Germany, turning her personal experience with online harassment into a broader conversation about digital abuse and women's safety.
